S.FORM: == Paka'orad == Tona mararid ko kedal no romi'ad, ma'icang ko sra, mafadi' a mapatay ko pinaloma ato pina'orip. Mikilim ko tamdaw to piradoman, makedal awaay ko nanom, marawraw ko finawlan no niyaro' to nika awa ko nanom. Itiya, palimo'ot ko kakomodan no niyaro' to sapalengaw to sapipaka'orad. Nanoya, o finawlan no niyaro', dengan o samamaay a awid ko masadakay (o roma, o maponengay no niyaro' a fafahiyan), miala to koliya nai lotok patayraen i fanaw ano eca i 'alo, mitatoy cangra maemin to koliya a mingitangit, ta milekal maemin a masasilesi' i cinanomay, matiya o misalamaay a ka'emangay to nanom a parahemed to tireng. Onini i, o sapa'araw i kawas no nanom to longoc nangra to 'orad, nanay samatiyaen o kasasilsil niyam to nanom ko pipafeli iso to 'orad i tamiyanan, o sanay ko tatodong no pihaen nangra. Tona mipaka'orad cangra, ano caay haca ko 'orad i, miliyaw haca a mipaka'orad to sakinatosa, kinatolo. Nanoya ira sato ko ca'of no kawas.. mahaen ko demak no pipaka'orad hananay.
S.PHON: == pakaʡo~uraɬ~ɮ == to~una marariɬ~ɮ ko~u kəɬ~ɮaɾ no~u ro~umiʡaɬ~ɮ, maʡiʦaŋ ko~u sra, mafaɬ~ɮiʡ a mapataj ko~u pinaɾo~uma ato~u pinaʡo~urip. mikiɾim ko~u tamɬ~ɮaw to~u piraɬ~ɮo~uman, makəɬ~ɮaɾ awaaj ko~u nano~um, marawraw ko~u finawɾan no~u nijaro~uʡ to~u nika awa ko~u nano~um. itija, paɾimo~uʡo~ut ko~u kako~umo~uɬ~ɮan no~u nijaro~uʡ to~u sapaɾəŋaw to~u sapipakaʡo~uraɬ~ɮ. nano~uja, o~u finawɾan no~u nijaro~uʡ, ɬ~ɮəŋan o~u samamaaj a awiɬ~ɮ ko~u masaɬ~ɮakaj (o~u ro~uma, o~u mapo~unəŋaj no~u nijaro~uʡ a fafaħijan), miaɾa to~u ko~uɾija nai ɾo~uto~uk patajraən i fanaw ano~u əʦa i ʡaɾo~u, mitato~uj ʦaŋra maəmin to~u ko~uɾija a miŋitaŋit, ta miɾəkaɾ maəmin a masasiɾəsiʡ i ʦinano~umaj, matija o~u misaɾamaaj a kaʡəmaŋaj to~u nano~um a paraħəməɬ~ɮ to~u tirəŋ. o~unini i, o~u sapaʡaraw i kawas no~u nano~um to~u ɾo~uŋo~uʦ naŋra to~u ʡo~uraɬ~ɮ, nanaj samatijaən o~u kasasiɾsiɾ nijam to~u nano~um ko~u pipafəɾi iso~u to~u ʡo~uraɬ~ɮ i tamijanan, o~u sanaj ko~u tato~uɬ~ɮo~uŋ no~u piħaən naŋra. to~una mipakaʡo~uraɬ~ɮ ʦaŋra, ano~u ʦaaj ħaʦa ko~u ʡo~uraɬ~ɮ i, miɾijaw ħaʦa a mipakaʡo~uraɬ~ɮ to~u sakinato~usa, kinato~uɾo~u. nano~uja ira sato~u ko~u ʦaʡo~uf no~u kawas.. maħaən ko~u ɬ~ɮəmak no~u pipakaʡo~uraɬ~ɮ ħananaj.
